title: LCM of 20 and 45 from prime factors
caption: The LCM uses every prime in the diagram once: 2 × 2 × 5 × 3 × 3 = 180. The shared 5 is counted only once.
alt: A Venn diagram: circle 20 holds 2, 2; circle 45 holds 3, 3; the overlap holds 5.
description: The primes both share, 5, go in the overlap.
The rest of 20's primes (2, 2) and of 45's (3, 3) go in their own parts.
All the primes together multiply to the LCM, 180.

checks.name: the overlap multiplies to the HCF, 5
